entries.title: Replenishment
entries.summary: Shared resource helper; raw DBC aura metadata is corrected before periodic execution.

execution.interpretation: The CoA script loader registers the resource talent hooks.
For Mana periodic energize, the load hook replaces the flat aura with OBS_MOD_POWER.
The periodic aura dispatcher routes OBS_MOD_POWER to HandleObsModPowerAuraTick.
Uses recipient max power and aura amount / 100; alive/power/immunity gates apply.

gaps: This maps the shared helper. Its class-specific callers and proc eligibility need separate traces.

entries.title: Spell acquisition through character advancement
entries.summary: DBC membership is a candidate; native loading and player eligibility decide acquisition.

execution.interpretation: Joins class/spec data, filters rank entries, resolves automatic dependencies and records each specialization's identity and signature entries.
Checks class, spec, rank, level and budget, with distinct automatic/free-choice rules.
Reads the specialization from identity and paid entries; entering another one without choosing its talents switches and restores its stored build, otherwise validates and applies the complete set.

gaps: Automatic grants, paid ranks and hidden helper spells are distinct; inspect the selected character context.
